data.name: Xiomara
data.gender_notes: Xiomara is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Xiomara is believed to derive from the Greek word 'Xioma' which means 'dew', 'moisture' or 'precious'. In Christian tradition, it can also be interpreted as a derivative of the Hebrew name 'Xiomas' meaning 'the Lord is gracious'. The name Xiomara carries the meaning “God's dew” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Xiomara usually hope their child will grow to embody god's dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's grace, dew from heaven, and new beginnings.
data.etymology: Xiomara belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's dew.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Xiomara total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: זיאומרה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים מוכן להיות מורם, מוכן לאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זיאומרה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הלטינית והספרדית, והוא קשור לנושא של הכנת אלוהים להיות מורם ומוכן לאל. השם מורכב מיסודות שונים ומשמעותו קשורה לרעיון של הכנה וקבלת הברכה האלוהית.

in_greek.name: Ξιομάρα
in_greek.meaning: Θεός έτοιμος να υψωθεί, έτοιμος για τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Ξιομάρα είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την λατινική και ισπανική γλώσσα, και συνδέεται με την έννοια της προετοιμασίας του Θεού για να υψωθεί και να είναι έτοιμος για τον Θεό. Το όνομα αυτό αποτελείται από διάφορες ρίζες και η σημασία του σχετίζεται με την ιδέα της προετοιμασίας και της λήψης της θείας ευλογίας.

in_latin.name: Xiomara
in_latin.meaning: Deus paratus est elevari, paratus Deo
in_latin.long_meaning: Xiomara est nomen quod ex lingua latina et hispanica oritur, et cum conceptu preparationis Dei ad elevandum et paratum esse Deo coniungitur. Nomen hoc ex variis radicibus componitur et significatio eius cum idea preparationis et acceptationis benedictionis divinae conectitur.
